data.name: Dilnawaz
data.gender_notes: Dilnawaz is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Dilnawaz is a name that signifies someone who is the delight or charm of the heart. It is derived from Persian words 'dil' meaning heart and 'nawaz' meaning caressing or charming. The name Dilnawaz carries the meaning “Heart's delight, charming” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Dilnawaz usually hope their child will grow to embody heart's delight, charming and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: The name conveys a sense of spiritual endearment and love, highlighting the importance of affection and kindness in Islam.
data.etymology: Dilnawaz belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Heart's delight, charming.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Dilnawaz total 9, giving a life-path number of 9. Number 9 is linked with Mars and with the qualities of compassion, idealism and generosity.
